<div class="message"><div class="meta">15:30 · Financial Director</div>
<strong>I don't need another spreadsheet. I need your recommendation.</strong>
<p>Which system should we take forward, why, and what do we still need to verify? Keep it to 100 words.</p></div>



<section class="obe"><div class="obe-head">Purpose → Outcome → Assessment criteria → Evidence</div><div class="obe-body">
<p><strong>Purpose of this stage:</strong> integrate quantitative evidence, uncertainty and professional scepticism into a concise management recommendation.</p>
<p><strong>Outcome for this stage:</strong> <strong>Formulate and communicate an evidence-based investment recommendation that integrates quantitative analysis, commercial trade-offs, uncertainty and professional scepticism.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Associated assessment criteria:</strong> a successful response identifies a proposal; uses at least two correctly interpreted quantitative results; explains one material trade-off; identifies an assumption requiring verification; distinguishes evidence from an unsupported supplier claim; and remains within 100 words.</p>
<p><strong>Evidence:</strong> recommendation in <span class="cell">Recommendation!A7</span> and professional-scepticism response in <span class="cell">Recommendation!A22</span>.</p>
</div></section>


<div class="platform-note">
  <div class="label">Excel + Google Sheets · Decide</div>
  <div class="platform-grid">
    <div class="platform"><strong>Excel</strong>Enter the recommendation in the response area beginning <span class="cell">Recommendation!A7</span>. Use Home → <strong>Wrap Text</strong> if necessary.</div>
    <div class="platform"><strong>Google Sheets</strong>Enter the recommendation in the same response area beginning <span class="cell">Recommendation!A7</span>. Use Format → Wrapping → <strong>Wrap</strong> if necessary.</div>

<div class="thread"><strong>Story so far:</strong> A is fastest on payback; C creates the greatest base-case NPV; B becomes preferable to C if C's self-consumption falls below roughly 74%.</div>
<section class="story"><div class="label">The case · The Financial Director wants a recommendation</div>
<h2>The spreadsheet gives evidence. It does not choose the decision rule.</h2>
<p>You now have a genuine commercial trade-off. Management needs a recommendation that distinguishes measured results from assumptions still requiring verification.</p></section>
<table><tr><th>Criterion</th><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th></tr>
<tr><td>Simple payback</td><td><strong>2.92 y</strong></td><td>2.96 y</td><td>3.22 y</td></tr>
<tr><td>20-year NPV</td><td>R2.152m</td><td>R2.662m</td><td><strong>R2.871m</strong></td></tr>
<tr><td>Self-consumption</td><td>90%</td><td>85%</td><td>78%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Primary exposure</td><td>Lower long-term value</td><td>Middle-ground option</td><td>Utilisation assumption</td></tr></table>

<div class="excel"><div class="label">Excel instruction · use the workbook as evidence</div><h3>Do not retype numbers from memory</h3>
<ul><li>Payback evidence: <span class="cell">Your Model!B7:D7</span>.</li><li>Base NPV evidence: first scenario row <span class="cell">Test Assumptions!B8:D8</span>.</li><li>Sensitivity evidence: <span class="cell">Test Assumptions!A8:E14</span>.</li><li>Write your final recommendation in the merged response area beginning at <span class="cell">Recommendation!A7</span> (displayed across A7:F13).</li></ul>
<p>Use <strong>Wrap Text</strong> if needed. Keep the recommendation to 100 words or fewer.</p></div>

<div class="caseq"><div class="label">Executive briefing task · ≤100 words</div><strong>Recommend one proposal to the Financial Director.</strong></div>
<ol><li>Name the selected proposal.</li><li>Use at least <strong>two quantified pieces of Excel evidence</strong>.</li><li>State one explicit commercial trade-off.</li><li>Name one unverified operational assumption that must be confirmed before contract signature.</li></ol>
<p><strong>There is no single acceptable recommendation if the reasoning is coherent, quantified and appropriately qualified.</strong></p>

<div class="card accent"><h3>Professional scepticism · Supplier C's environmental claim</h3>
<p>Supplier C states that its panels have a lower lifecycle environmental impact but provides no independently verified evidence.</p>
<p><strong>What evidence would you request before allowing the claim to influence the recommendation?</strong></p></div>
<div class="excel"><div class="label">Excel instruction · record your scepticism response</div>
<p>Go to <span class="cell">Recommendation!A22</span> (merged across A22:F26) and type your response. Consider lifecycle methodology, manufacturing impacts, expected service life, recyclability, independent certification, system boundaries and the basis of comparison with A and B.</p></div>
<div class="output"><strong>Evidence produced:</strong> ≤100-word recommendation in <span class="cell">Recommendation!A7</span> + evidence request in <span class="cell">Recommendation!A22</span>.</div>
